cve_summary: The ScrollView::paint function in platform/scroll/ScrollView.cpp in Blink, as used in Google Chrome before 35.0.1916.114, allows remote attackers to spoof the UI by extending scrollbar painting into the parent frame.
commit_message:
Do not attempt to open a channel to a plugin in Plugin Data Remover if there are no plugins available.

BUG=485886

Review URL: https://codereview.chromium.org/1144353003

Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/master@{#331168}
docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
 * Summary:  
 * Initializes the plugin on the IO thread based on the provided MIME type.  
 *  
 * Parameters:  
 * mime_type (const std::string&): The MIME type of the plugin to initialize.  
 *  
 * Returns:  
 * None  
 *  
 * Logic:  
 * Retrieves the plugin information for the specified MIME type. If no plugins are found, it signals an event and exits. If a plugin is found, it retrieves the plugin path and checks if it is a Pepper plugin or an NPAPI plugin, then opens the appropriate communication channel. The function ensures that it runs on the IO thread and manages the reference count for the object until the channel is opened or an error occurs.  
 ******************************************************************************/
